Name: Disable Building Fade
Author: calebstein1
Description:
This mod disables building transparency when the player walks behind a building. If [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is installed, you'll get a toggle in the Mod Settings to turn transparency on or off.

Idea from the Reddit thread [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/StardewValleyMods/comments/1d1swvu/mod_to_disable_buildings_fadingbecoming/]here[/url].

Known Bugs:
[list]
[*]The settings toggle state doesn't save between game launches (if you enable transparency, it will be disabled again the next time you launch the game)
[*]If you use the settings toggle to disable transparency while the player is behind a building that's currently semi-transparent, the building will remain transparent even after the player walks away from it (re-enabling transparency will fix the visual bug)
[/list]
Source available on [url=https://github.com/calebstein1/StardewDisableBuildingFade]Github[/url]
